summary: E2E frontend testing of Iter 65 — project-wide customer chat. Created test project proj_3baf81f954ff with a gig and worker.demo assigned, then exercised all 6 requested flows: admin create-thread dialog (with participant picker + All/None toggle), edit participants (toast verified), customer public view (PROJECT label + project_title), contractor view (PROJECT badge + privacy: only first name), manual close (toast + status flip + closed-banner on customer page + disabled composer). Test data cleaned up. 6/6 PASS.

test_results.admin_create_flow: PASS — /ops/projects/{id} loads, proj-customer-chat-btn opens dialog titled 'Project customer chat'. project-thread-name + project-thread-email fill correctly. project-thread-pick-none flips picker to (0/1); project-thread-pick-all flips back to (1/1). project-thread-create produces thread row project-thread-row-cthr_6895102b00dd with copy/edit/close buttons + 'active' green status badge. Link format: https://hcobnetwork.com/c/<token> (production host by design — noted in prior iteration).
test_results.admin_edit_participants: PASS — project-thread-edit-{id} reveals checkbox list with project-thread-edit-pick-{tid}-{worker_id}. Toggling checkbox + clicking project-thread-save-{id} shows toast 'Participants updated' as expected.
test_results.customer_view_public: PASS — /c/<token> renders without auth in fresh browser context. Header shows 'PROJECT' subtitle and customer-chat-gig-title = 'TEST_iter65_project_chat' (project title shown to customer, choice 5a). Composer + Send button functional. Sent message appears as blue right-aligned bubble.
test_results.contractor_view_project_thread: PASS — Worker.demo logged in, /crew/assignments/{gig_id} loads worker-customer-chat-panel. Thread card shows first name 'Jane' + green 'PROJECT' badge + 'LIVE' status badge (in addition to per-gig threads area). Expanding via crew-customer-thread-toggle-{tid} reveals message history; composer crew-customer-composer-{tid} + send button crew-customer-send-{tid} successfully posts contractor reply (visible blue right-aligned bubble).
test_results.privacy_check: PASS — On contractor view, body text contains 'Jane' but NOT 'Jane Test' (full name), NOT 'jane.test@example.com' (email), NOT 'JV5u5BQQBzXz' (token). All three privacy assertions hold.
test_results.manual_close_flow: PASS — Clicked project-thread-close-{id} from admin dialog, accepted window.confirm, toast 'Chat closed' shown. Status badge flipped from 'active' to 'CLOSED' (gray). project-thread-reopen-{id} button now visible. Customer page (/c/<token>) in fresh context renders customer-chat-closed-banner; Send button is disabled (is_disabled == True). Thread reopened after test for tidy state.

critical_code_review_comments: ProjectCustomerChatDialog renders DialogContent WITHOUT a DialogDescription / aria-describedby — Radix warned twice in the console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Add a <DialogDescription> below DialogTitle (e.g. 'Generate a shareable link for the customer to chat with the picked contractors').
(Pre-existing, not introduced by Iter 65) Hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' from FeedFilters.jsx — already flagged in iter48.

(Pre-existing, by design per feature note) Customer link is constructed with the production hostname 'https://hcobnetwork.com'; preview testing requires substituting REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Consider env-driven base URL so non-prod copy-paste links work.
action_items: Add a DialogDescription to ProjectCustomerChatDialog to silence the Radix aria-describedby console warning (low priority, accessibility nit).
seed_data_creation: Created and DELETED test project proj_3baf81f954ff (TEST_iter65_project_chat) + gig gig_cae01dc44931 (TEST_iter65_gig) + worker.demo assignment acc_b36fd9f45b96 + project customer thread cthr_6895102b00dd (Jane Test). All cleaned up at end of run.
